title: U.S. Strategy in Asia Spurs Tensions Over Taiwan: A Geopolitical Standoff
description: The U.S. is accused by Russia of provoking a crisis in Asia by supporting Taiwan militarily, violating the 'one China' principle. Russia aligns with China in opposing U.S. actions, highlighting a growing geopolitical tension. Recent U.S. military aid to Taiwan exacerbates the situation amidst increased U.S.-Taiwan ties.

title: War Simulation Reveals Taiwan's Month-long Defense Requirement Against China
description: A US congressional committee and a think tank conducted a simulation suggesting that Taiwan would need to independently defend itself for up to two months in case of a Chinese invasion. The study highlighted Taiwan's strategic geographical advantages and challenges posed by China's military capabilities.

title: Chinese Films Dominate at Taiwan's Golden Horse Awards
description: Films from China, focused on the COVID pandemic and LGBTQ+ themes, won top honors at Taiwan's Golden Horse awards. 'An Unfinished Film' by Lou Ye took Best Film and Best Director, while 'Bel Ami' from Geng Jun secured accolades for acting and cinematography, highlighting artistic freedom in Taiwan.

title: China is laying the legal groundwork to seize Taiwan
description: A likely precursor to any use of force by Beijing will be a public assertion of sovereignty over Taiwan.

title: Taiwan President Visits Pacific Allies as China Expands Influence
description: Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te will visit three key South Pacific island nations that are increasingly under China's influence.

title: China Responds to US After Rejecting Defense Talks
description: China accused the United States of disrespecting its "core interests" by continuing weapon sales to Taiwan.

title: Taiwan president to visit allies in South Pacific as rival China seeks inroads
description: Taiwan's government has yet to confirm whether Lai will make a stop in Hawaii, although such visits are routine and unconfirmed Taiwanese media reports say he will stay for more than one day.

title: Taiwan Battles for Influence Amid China's South Pacific Advance
description: Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te will visit allies in the South Pacific amid ongoing Chinese diplomatic advances. His trip highlights Taiwan's efforts to maintain its limited diplomatic ties and counter China's influence in the region, as relations with traditional allies shift under Beijing's economic and political pressures.

title: Taiwan president will visit allies in South Pacific as rival China seeks inroads
description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te will visit the self-governing island’s allies in the South Pacific, where rival China has been seeking diplomatic inroads.

title: Taiwan's Strategic Pacific Diplomacy Tour Amid Tensions
description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te plans a diplomatic visit to three Pacific allies amid growing tensions with China. The tour is notable due to potential U.S. stopovers, although details remain undisclosed. China's military activities in the region pose ongoing challenges to Taiwan's international diplomacy.
